import pytest
from collections import OrderedDict

def test_lru_cache_happy_path():
    """Test basic LRU cache operations."""
    get, put = lru_cache(2)

    # Put some values
    put(1, 1)
    put(2, 2)

    # Get existing values
    assert get(1) == 1
    assert get(2) == 2

    # Put a new value, evicting the least recently used
    put(3, 3)
    assert get(1) == -1  # 1 was evicted
    assert get(2) == 2
    assert get(3) == 3

    # Access 2 to make it recently used
    assert get(2) == 2

    # Put another value, evicting 3 (not 2)
    put(4, 4)
    assert get(2) == 2
    assert get(3) == -1  # 3 was evicted
    assert get(4) == 4

def test_lru_cache_capacity_one():
    """Test LRU cache with capacity 1."""
    get, put = lru_cache(1)

    put(1, 1)
    assert get(1) == 1

    put(2, 2)
    assert get(1) == -1  # 1 was evicted
    assert get(2) == 2

def test_lru_cache_get_nonexistent_key():
    """Test getting a non-existent key."""
    get, put = lru_cache(2)

    assert get(1) == -1  # Key doesn't exist

    put(1, 1)
    assert get(2) == -1  # Key doesn't exist

def test_lru_cache_update_existing_key():
    """Test updating an existing key."""
    get, put = lru_cache(2)

    put(1, 1)
    assert get(1) == 1

    put(1, 10)  # Update value
    assert get(1) == 10

def test_lru_cache_eviction_order():
    """Test that eviction follows LRU order."""
    get, put = lru_cache(2)

    put(1, 1)
    put(2, 2)
    put(3, 3)  # Evicts 1

    assert get(1) == -1
    assert get(2) == 2
    assert get(3) == 3

    # Access 2 to make it recently used
    assert get(2) == 2

    put(4, 4)  # Evicts 3 (not 2)
    assert get(2) == 2
    assert get(3) == -1
    assert get(4) == 4

def test_lru_cache_capacity_zero():
    """Test LRU cache with capacity 0 (edge case)."""
    get, put = lru_cache(0)

    put(1, 1)
    assert get(1) == -1  # Nothing should be stored

    put(2, 2)
    assert get(2) == -1  # Nothing should be stored

def test_lru_cache_negative_capacity():
    """Test LRU cache with negative capacity (error case)."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        lru_cache(-1)

def test_lru_cache_non_integer_capacity():
    """Test LRU cache with non-integer capacity (error case)."""
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        lru_cache("not_an_integer")
